title: Count Largest Group
description: Group numbers from 1 to n by sum of digits and return the count of groups with the maximum size.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize empty hash map groups
2. For i from 1 to n:
3.   sum = getSumOfDigits(i)
4.   groups[sum]++
5. max_size = max(groups.values)
6. count = number of groups with size == max_size

steps.note: Initialize empty frequency array to store counts for each digit sum (max sum for 13 is 9, 10 is 1, 11 is 2, 12 is 3, 13 is 4)
After processing 1-9: sums 1-9 each appear once. After 10: 1+0=1, 11: 1+1=2, 12: 1+2=3, 13: 1+3=4
Identify max group size. Sizes are: sum 1:2, sum 2:2, sum 3:2, sum 4:2, sum 5-9:1. Max size is 2.
Count groups with size 2. There are 4 such groups (sums 1, 2, 3, 4). Return 4.
